meta.title: 为什么他们深受顶奢品牌的追捧
meta.title_en: Why Top Luxury Brands Love Their Faces
meta.topic: 审美 · 面部空间透视

scenes.title_cn: 立论：顶奢偏爱的是空间透视
scenes.title_en: Thesis: Luxury Brands Love Spatial Perspective
scenes.context: 顶奢品牌钟爱某些脸不是因为咖位大，而是面部美学：高级的好看=轮廓流畅+空间透视（从前向后的延伸感+横平竖直结构）。
sentences: 这些顶奢品牌为何独独钟爱于他们？只是因为咖位大吗？
Why do these top luxury brands favor them alone? Is it just about star power?
star power（咖位）
在轮廓流畅的同时，面部是有空间透视的，面中区到后方的颊后区是有从前向后的延伸感的。
Beyond smooth contours, the face has spatial perspective — the mid-face stretches back toward the cheek zone.
spatial perspective（空间透视）
paraphrase: 「从前向后的延伸感」换种说法
A depth that runs front to back.
scenes.speak: Why do these top luxury brands favor them alone? Is it just about star power? Beyond smooth contours, the face has spatial perspective — the mid-face stretches back toward the cheek zone.

scenes.title_cn: 两个平行四边形=电影脸的来源
scenes.title_en: Two Parallelograms Build the Cinema Face
scenes.context: 前后上下的骨骼高点构成上下两个平行四边形。电影脸因它们而有轮廓流畅自然高级的结构；淡系美女只有平面包裹关系，上镜脸摊成一片。
sentences: 前后上下的骨骼高点，分别构成了上下两个平行四边形。
The front-back and top-down bone high points each form an upper and a lower parallelogram.
bone high points（骨骼高点）
电影脸正是因为这两个平行四边形的存在，才有了轮廓流畅自然高级的面部结构。
It's precisely these two parallelograms that give a cinema face its smooth, natural, refined structure.
a cinema face（电影脸）
淡系美女只有左右宽窄的平面包裹关系，缺乏从前到后的纵深感，上镜时脸摊成一片。
Soft-feature beauties only have a left-right planar wrap — lacking depth, the face flattens on camera.
planar wrap（平面包裹）
paraphrase: It goes flat in front of the lens.
scenes.speak: The front-back and top-down bone high points each form an upper and a lower parallelogram. It's precisely these two parallelograms that give a cinema face its smooth, natural, refined structure. Soft-feature beauties only have a left-right planar wrap — lacking depth, the face flattens on camera.

scenes.title_cn: 上面部平行四边形：ABCD 法则
scenes.title_en: The Upper Parallelogram: The A-B-C-D Rule
scenes.context: 空间透视要有面部高点（眉弓、颧骨、下颌角），由点线面构成平行或包裹关系。上面部平行四边形：A颞线、B太阳穴发际线、C鬓角发际线、D眉弓-颧弓连线。AB平行、CD平行，才有一前一后一宽一窄。
sentences: 首先就是要有面部高点，比如眉弓、颧骨、下颌角等。
First, the face needs high points — like the brow ridge, cheekbones, and jaw angles.
the brow ridge（眉弓）
上面部的平行四边形由ABCD四条线构成：A是我们的颞线，B是太阳穴发际线，C是鬓角发际线，D是从眉弓转折点到颧弓最宽点的连线。
The upper parallelogram is four lines: A the temporal line, B the temple hairline, C the sideburn hairline, D from the brow turn to the widest point of the zygomatic arch.
the zygomatic arch（颧弓）
A要和B趋近于平行，C和D要平行，这两组线条才能呈现出一前一后、一宽一窄的空间关系。
A should be near-parallel to B, and C parallel to D, so the two sets show one front one back, one wide one narrow.
near-parallel（趋近平行）
paraphrase: 「一前一后一宽一窄」换种说法
A contrast in both depth and width.
scenes.speak: First, the face needs high points — like the brow ridge, cheekbones, and jaw angles. The upper parallelogram is four lines: A the temporal line, B the temple hairline, C the sideburn hairline, D from the brow turn to the widest point of the zygomatic arch. A should be near-parallel to B, and C parallel to D, so the two sets show one front one back, one wide one narrow.

scenes.title_en: Unbalanced Faces and the Wrong Fix
scenes.context: 菱形脸或高颧骨的人平行四边形直接缺失或AB不平行，导致颧骨成为上面部最宽点。错误审美只加宽太阳穴，不模拟体块关系，得到圆滚滚无结构的上庭。
sentences: 菱形脸或者高颧骨的人，往往是这个平行四边形直接缺失，或者是A和B构不成平行关系，就会导致颧骨成为上面部最宽点。
Diamond faces or high cheekbones usually have that parallelogram missing — or A and B fail to be parallel — so the cheekbone becomes the widest point.
a diamond face（菱形脸）
不懂得面部体块的人，会让你直接加宽太阳穴，却不模拟出这个平行四边形的体块关系。
Those who don't get facial volume just widen your temples, without rebuilding the parallelogram mass.
facial volume（面部体块）
按照错误的审美，你只会得到一个圆滚滚、没有结构关系和光影关系的上庭。
With the wrong aesthetic, you get a round upper-third with no structure and no light-shadow relationship.
the upper-third（上庭）
paraphrase: The cheekbone takes over as the widest feature.
scenes.speak: Diamond faces or high cheekbones usually have that parallelogram missing — or A and B fail to be parallel — so the cheekbone becomes the widest point. Those who don't get facial volume just widen your temples, without rebuilding the parallelogram mass. With the wrong aesthetic, you get a round upper-third with no structure and no light-shadow relationship.

scenes.title_cn: 下面部平行四边形与结论
scenes.title_en: The Lower Parallelogram and the Takeaway
scenes.context: 下面部平行四边形由颧弓后段、颧骨表现点、下颌拐点、下颌-颏部转折点构成。下颌由两条线构成，不能处理成一条线。下庭圆润=二维局限；头重脚轻不符合顶奢审美，把专业的事交给专业的人。
sentences: 下面部的平行四边形，由颧弓后段、颧骨表现点、下颌拐点、下颌与颏部转折点构成。
The lower parallelogram is built from the back zygomatic arch, the cheekbone highlight, the jaw angle, and the jaw-to-chin pivot.
the jaw-to-chin pivot（下颌-颏部转折点）
我们的下颌这一段是由两条线构成的，在变美的时候不能处理成一条线。
Our jaw is made of two lines — when enhancing the face, never merge it into one.
two lines（两条线）
有结果的人只做一件事——把专业的事交给专业的人。
People who get results do just one thing — leave the expertise to the experts.
leave it to the experts（交给专业的人）
paraphrase: Pay for it with trial and error.
scenes.speak: The lower parallelogram is built from the back zygomatic arch, the cheekbone highlight, the jaw angle, and the jaw-to-chin pivot. Our jaw is made of two lines — when enhancing the face, never merge it into one. People who get results do just one thing — leave the expertise to the experts.

practice.a: Leave the expertise to the experts.

pitfalls: Treat beauty as just smooth contours.
Add spatial perspective: depth plus structure.
The luxury look needs both contour and volume.
Fix a diamond face by widening the temples.
Widening alone yields a round, structureless upper-third.
Smooth the jaw into one single line.
Keep the jaw as two lines with a backward turn.
One line removes the depth that carries the cinema face.
Build an aesthetic system, then hire experts.
Those without the framework pay school fees on their journey.
shifts: 以为好看=轮廓流畅，顶奢选人只看咖位
看见空间透视：两个平行四边形决定电影脸
difficult_words: It's not just about star power.
The bone high points form parallelograms.
The brow ridge and jaw angles.
The widest point of the zygomatic arch.
A should be near-parallel to B.
A round lower-third traps beauty in 2D.
Lacking depth, it flattens on camera.
footer_notes: 原视频为面部美学口播（作者：张亚航），转录为繁体已转简体，英文为场景意译，适合跟读学习审美表达；ASR 术语已按语境校正（頂遮→顶奢、庫茨→古驰、夾後區→颊后区、橫屏豎直→横平竖直、重生感/緊身→纵深、捏線→颞线、拳弓→颧弓、拳骨→颧骨、下和→下颌、磕部→颏部、上停/下停→上庭/下庭）。
